al_roadside_boulders_shelter_boulders.blurb: A small group of sandstone boulders at Horse Pens 40 near Steele, the first blocks you reach beside the road into the campground. The problems run from the easiest grades through a few real tests: a handful sit in the lower V grades, two near V7, and one hard problem around V9. Horse Pens 40 is known for sloping holds, good landings and a hardwood canopy, and friction is at its best in the cool part of the year. There is almost no walk, so it works as an easy start or a warm-down.
